header.name: mcs51 CMS8S78xx LVD 4.0V threshold detection headless proof

steps.description: Virtual VDD sense (rail key 62, board-channel space) at 5.0V, above the 4.0V LVD threshold. NOTE: INPUT_POWER is intentionally unused (no executor in this topology); the virtual sense key is the behavioral VDD injection seam.
[Power-on baseline] P3.2 stays at initial low 0, no LVD interrupt
[First trigger] LVD interrupt (Vector 26), ISR runs P32=~P32 flipping to 1
[Anti-storm hold] sustained 3.5V undervoltage, cleared flag never re-fires, P3.2 stable at 1
VDD recovers to 5.0V (past the 4.1V hysteresis line, re-armed)
VDD drops a second time to 3.5V
[Second trigger] re-armed detector catches the drop again, ISR flips P3.2 back to 0
